text:
maria: Quick check — planning to roll out the structured-output compatibility shim for function-calling next week. Proposed plan: server-side gate + phased audience sweep (internal -> partners -> gradual public). Questions: SDK default behavior (opt-in vs opt-out), explicit guardrails for fallback, and the primary metrics we should watch.

kevin: +1 to default OFF in SDKs. Prefer a server-side flag that can be toggled per-customer. SDK opt-in via client config is safest. Example flag payload:
```
feature_flags.set("so_fncall_shim", {"enabled": true, "audience_pct": 1, "buckets": ["internal","partners"]})
```
I'll add a CLI command to flip small audiences.

sophie: For SDKs we should detect schema mismatch and force fallback to legacy text output if we see unexpected fields. Proposal:
```
if (resp.schema_version !== expected) {
  log('so_shim:mismatch')
  return legacyParse(resp.text)
}
```
Also need clear docs for integrators about how to opt in.

nate: Metrics to instrument:
- so.accept_rate (how often responses match structured schema)
- so.fallback_rate
- so.latency_p95
- so.quality.eval_regressions (compare to baseline prompts)
We should wire these into the console and create a regression alert for evaluation drift.

ram: Ops note — set a hard guardrail: if fallback_rate > 5% for 30m in any customer cohort, automatically disable the flag for that cohort and page the oncall. Also rate-limit retries to avoid thundering herd during rollouts.

devops-bot: smoke-test-runner: Staging smoke tests started for shim rollout (build id: build-2026.03.17.12). Running: compatibility suite + prompt-set evaluation.

iris: I'll run the cross-SDK scenarios tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll also seed partner accounts (3 customers) as audience buckets. Can we get a confirmation on the rollout cadence? Suggest: 1% internal -> 5% partners -> 20% public beta -> 100% in 2 weeks if no regressions.

maria: Cadence ack. Action items:
- @kevin add server-side flag toggle + CLI patch
- @sophie add mismatch fallback in SDK + docs
- @nate hook metrics into console and create the initial dashboards
- @ram add guardrail automation and pager rule
- @iris run staged cross-sdk tests tomorrow
I'll post a short runbook for rollback and add it to the feature flag page. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: roll/so-shim-v1 to canary (internal bucket). ETA ~15m.

kevin: Ping me once canary is up, I'll do a quick smoke to validate toggling and bucket routing.

sophie: I'll prepare an example in the SDK readme showing opt-in config + graceful fallback snippet.

maria: Thanks all — we'll sync async updates here. If anyone sees unexpected spikes, @ram please escalate immediately.
